title: ASE Certification Practice Tests
content:
ASE A6 Electrical Electronics Practice Test
50. The backup view on the vehicle’s navigation display is crooked. Technician A says this is most likely caused by a faulty display. Technician B says the backup camera could be out of alignment. Who is correct?
- A. Technician A
- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
- D. Neither A or B
